source_caption:
🎬 A Home of Our Own (1993)

A Home of Our Own follows Frances Lacey, a determined single mother raising six children while struggling to overcome poverty and financial hardship. Hoping to provide her family with a better future, Frances leaves Los Angeles and travels to rural Idaho, where she discovers an unfinished house that she dreams of turning into a permanent home. With limited money and resources, she works tirelessly alongside her children to rebuild the property while facing numerous obstacles and personal hardships. Despite her stubborn personality and reluctance to accept help from others, Frances gradually discovers the importance of community, kindness, and trusting those around her. Starring Kathy Bates and Edward Furlong, the film delivers heartfelt performances and emotional storytelling while exploring motherhood, sacrifice, perseverance, family unity, and the extraordinary determination of a mother willing to overcome any obstacle to give her children a place to call home.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Family

⭐ IMDb: 7.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 44m • PG

🎥 Director: Tony Bill

✍️ Writer: Patrick Sheane Duncan

📍 Setting: Rural Idaho during the 1960s.
